x: Charlie Jones was our best performer but Bert Machell and Geoff. Freestone have possibilities, and Frank Norman has started to train for this event.
Young Geoff. Freestone ran well to beat Dicky Dumbrill for premier honours with Hawkins in third place.
Alan Sexton, now running for his school, beat Dick Negus in the 100, and also won the 220 Yards. Geoff.
Dick Negus won the 100 Yards and also the High and Long Jumps. Geoff.

His style is by no means good, but with a concentrated study of technique should be able to show considerable improvement on his throwing of this season. Geoff. Freestone, George Powell and Len Higgins have lent valuable assistance in this event.
